fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) surged 140% in 2026, benefiting from growth in the AI data center GPU market and the transition of AI workloads from training to inference.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD's Q3 revenue reached $13.4B, up 45% year-over-year, with 66% growth expected for the current quarter, server CPU revenue more than doubled year-over-year with over 100% growth expected by 2027.
fields.summary_ko.2: Nvidia (NVDA) declined 20% in 2026 amid headwinds including founder and former CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, while AMD's earnings per share (EPS) is expected to more than triple from 2026 to 2028.
